note: An experimental motor's own nozzle exit diameter is read from its .rse file now. That was the one place the app had no other source: the nozzle database covers AeroTech and Loki catalogue motors, and a motor you import matches nothing in it, so the exit - which since v0.119 buys thrust as the air thins, not only drag - had to be typed in by hand. It did not stay typed either: an imported motor was invisible to the machinery that keeps that field in step with the motor, so a stage flying one read as having no motor at all and changing motors cleared the number you had measured. The file's value is used now, in millimetres, and the panel says the file is where it came from rather than crediting a manufacturer with a figure out of your own file. A value that cannot be an exit plane for the case diameter in the same file - under 15 percent of it or over 75 percent, bounds taken from the 279 real nozzles in the database - is ignored with a note rather than flown. The throat is still not read; nothing in the app uses one. Everything in v0.136 is unchanged and still applies.
